declared_rules.prereg: docs/phase4_prereg_2026-08-22.md section 2.1; rules R7-R12 of section 1
declared_rules.channel_1: per-token-type mean SAE code over ALL cache rows of that type, projected mean_code @ W_dec (no b_dec) -> 1152-d, exactly scripts/22 stage 1, at the flag's own layer. Identical for every clustering arm: the arms differ in how the cosine GRAPH is built, not in the point coordinates. Raw residual R_L from results/phase3_token_type_mean_resid_fulln.npz is additionally reported for L4-L9 as a SECONDARY, non-verdict coordinate system.
declared_rules.channel_2: identity-removed lag+1 successor-delta type means, scripts/41b construction verbatim: delta_t(+1) = mean over admissible pairs (i, i+1) with tok(i) of type t of [code(row i+1) - TM[type(row i+1)]] @ W_dec, parity halves pooled by pair count, drop rule applied. L6/L7 are READ from results/phase3_lag_action_robust_deltas.npz; L0-L4 and L10 are computed here by a CPU cache stream of the same construction.
declared_rules.statistic: two_channel_rho = max over the 2k cyclic shifts/reflections of the Spearman correlation between the two recovered angular ORDERS (fits.cyclic_order_score convention, order-vs-order; no labels enter). Angles are taken in each channel's own top-2 PCA plane of the members' centred coordinates. Ties broken by a seeded random jitter, seed 0.
declared_rules.R10_drop: prereg R10 states the rule AND its frozen outcome: coordinate 1038 at L3-L10, coordinate 1125 at L0-L2, dropped from EVERY coordinate system before any plane fit. Applied as the frozen constant to channel 1 (which has no split-half in this pipeline) and, for the layers streamed here, RECOMPUTED by scripts/41b outlier_drop_rule on channel 2 and asserted equal to the frozen constant; disagreement is reported, never silently accepted. For L6/L7 the stored npz is already post-drop.
declared_rules.closure: frozen: gap_ratio < 2.5 (fits.circularity on the Kasa fit), k-independent
declared_rules.null: per (layer, k): 6,000 cluster-like k-sets = random seed type + its k-1 nearest by CENTRED cosine in channel-1 coordinates (centred cosine regardless of the flag's arm). CONDITIONAL background = the draws with gap_ratio < 2.5. Threshold = 99th percentile of two_channel_rho over that conditional set, exact order statistic (np.percentile method='higher'); the observed rho must be STRICTLY ABOVE it. n_passers is recorded per cell. 2,000 random and 2,000 frequency-matched k-sets are additionally reported, never used as the gate.
declared_rules.PASS: gap_ratio < 2.5 AND two_channel_rho > threshold(layer, k) AND both properties hold at every leave-one-out. LOO convention (pinned here, 2.1 does not state it): a LOO subset has size k-1, so its closure uses the same k-independent 2.5 and its rho uses threshold(layer, k-1) from a null computed at k-1. R8 gates CANDIDATES at k >= 9, not the k-1 LOO subsets of a candidate.
declared_rules.R8: a two-channel verdict exists only for k >= 9. k < 9 flags are reported under closure and closure-LOO only and are labelled NOT ADJUDICABLE.
declared_rules.lag2_specificity: per the erratum, lag+2 is a specificity control: a passer whose lag+2 rho also clears the 99th percentile of the lag+2 conditional null is flagged for R11 review. Computed at adjudicated cells only.

controls.positive: the L6 k=13 (hash 7d1d75a303d6) and L7 k=14 (hash 6bb0e54cd127) month flags must PASS; strict-12 and the 13/14-set are both reported
controls.negative_ordinal: ' one'..' ten' as single in-pool token ids, at L6 and L7, through the identical path; must not pass
controls.negative_freq_pseudo: 200 frequency-code pseudo-populations built by scripts/41b freq_pseudo_null's rule (each member replaced by one of its 5 nearest-log-count non-calendar pool types), anchored on the L6 13-set and the L7 14-set, through the full path; must give 0 passes
controls.negative_class_perm: 200 class-block-permuted draws: the CHANNEL-2 rows are permuted among types WITHIN each lexical block (leading_space x capitalized, scripts/41b resolve_blocks), which destroys the type-specific channel1<->channel2 correspondence while preserving class-level coupling. The anchor member set is re-adjudicated. This is the direct measurement of R11 tier leakage; must give <= 2 passes

declared_rules.planted: k=12 ring planted by REPLACEMENT IN PLANE (repo convention, scripts/39 and 41b): 12 random pool types are the carriers; in their own top-2 channel-1 plane their coordinates are replaced by centre + r*(cos t, sin t) plus Gaussian in-plane jitter of sd rho*r, out-of-plane components kept. r is the L6 13-set's own fitted channel-1 radius (pinned at run time in results.planted.radius_channel1). Channel 2 carries the SAME cyclic order with an INDEPENDENT jitter draw at the L6 13-set's fitted channel-2 radius. 200 plants per rho in [0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5]; recall of closure, of two-channel, and joint; rho80 by linear interpolation on the recall curve.
declared_rules.blind_population: prereg 2.1 declares 10 non-calendar flags with k >= 9. The flags file holds 12 flags at k >= 9, of which 3 carry calendar labels (L6 k=13 and L7 k=14 = the month positive controls; L0 k=10 = 'raw_refined', label_sets {months: 4}). The strictly non-calendar k >= 9 population is therefore 9, not 10. ALL 12 are adjudicated; the L0 k=10 flag is reported as calendar-bearing and OUTSIDE the blind population. Expected false passers are reported both ways: 9 x 0.01 = 0.09 and 10 x 0.01 = 0.10.
declared_rules.member_reconstruction: member_hash is md5(','.join(sorted POOL POSITIONS))[:12], verified against HASH_13. Members are recovered by re-running scripts/22 stage 1 + stage 2 (both Leiden arms, both refined arms, HDBSCAN) per layer and matching hashes. Acceptance: the reconstructed cluster's PRE-drop gap_ratio must reproduce the stored flag value to 1e-6. Fallback if a hash is absent: same (layer, arm), same k, best Jaccard over the flag's stored token_strings, same gap_ratio reproduction requirement. A flag that cannot be reconstructed is reported NOT RECONSTRUCTED and is never silently skipped.
declared_rules.co_reported_non_verdict: PASS_noLOO and PASS_LOO_rho_only are reported beside the frozen PASS so the tier can be read separately from the LOO conjunct. They decide nothing.
deviations: L0 channel-2 deltas are computed although 2.1 names only L1, L2, L3, L4, L10; this is an ADDITION that makes every k >= 9 flag adjudicable and changes no threshold, no statistic and no gate. Declared here, before any read.
2.1's blind population count (10 non-calendar k >= 9) does not match the flags file (9 strictly non-calendar; L0 k=10 carries 4 month labels). Both readings are reported; no flag is dropped.
The LOO threshold convention and the percentile convention are pinned here because 2.1 does not state them.
